item.title: This ‘KPop Demon Hunters’ Sword Is the Closest Thing to a Lightsaber for Rumi Fans: Buy Online
item.description:
[Intro music plays]
Host: "Hey there, KPop Demon Hunters fans! We've got some exciting news for you. A brand new, interactive Rumi sword is on its way, and it's available for preorder now. Let's dive into the details."
[Sound effects: A quick sound bite from the KPop Demon Hunters movie]
Host: "This premium electronic replica is a full-size, 40-inch sword that features motion-activated lighting and sound effects from the movie. It's made of plastic, of course, but it's designed to mimic the sleek, Art Deco look of Rumi's primary weapon, the sain-geom, or Four Tiger Sword."
[Sound effects: A sound bite of the sword's sound effects]
Host: "The sword has four modes, with over 50 LEDs and sound effects inspired by the film. It responds to movement, music, and even your own singing, unlocking unique light patterns as you swing and sway to the rhythm. And, with a rechargeable battery and USB-C port, you can display it on a shelf with the lights on, using the included clear, purple-tinted stand."
[Sound effects: A quick sound bite of music and singing]
Host: "This collector's item is priced at $224.99, which might seem steep, but considering its size and features, it's a must-have for any serious KPop Demon Hunters fan. And, if you can't wait until the July 1, 2027 release date, you can always check out the KPop Demon Hunters Nerf swords, which are available now and selling out fast."
[Outro music plays]
Host: "So, what are you waiting for? Head to Amazon to preorder your interactive Rumi sword, and get ready to take your cosplay game to the next level. Thanks for tuning in, and we'll catch you in the next episode!"
[Outro music continues to play until the end]
